svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each state, on a log scale whose second axis is the box's CPU, 1.45 times as long, beside the box's steps (a voice reply's alone, 12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms; the agents' at 24 agent sessions, 38 ms), for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 3.2% of stock's in every state) and the configuration to deploy (its change to the step from −30 to +1,486 µs): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 320, 323 and 376 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 792, 800 and 883 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,705, 2,723 and 2,854 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,562, 1,575 and 1,613 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 683, 685 and 720 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 336, 339 and 674 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 803, 806 and 1,163 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,618, 2,638 and 3,082 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,637, 2,664 and 3,114 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,566, 1,572 and 3,058 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 178, 180 and 331 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 663, 668 and 847 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,579, 2,615 and 2,865 µs; in the serving profile, only agents, 2 running: 66, 68 and 86 µs; in the serving profile, a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits, 2 running: 113, 115 and 84 µs; in the serving profile, a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 232, 238 and 316 µs; in the serving profile, the step that preempts for a waiting turn, 2 running: 190, 194 and 672 µs.
